name: DeepSeek API
label: Pricing
sw: Direct API ina input na output token pricing. DeepSeek Flash kwenye provider mwingine inaweza kuwa offer tofauti.
en: The direct API bills input and output tokens. A DeepSeek Flash offer from another provider is a separate route.

name: Z.AI · GLM
label: Pricing
sw: GLM-4.7-Flash imeandikwa Free; GLM-5.3-Flash ina token pricing. Check exact model ID na quota ya account.
en: GLM-4.7-Flash is listed as free; GLM-5.3-Flash has token prices. Check the exact model ID and account quota.

name: Anthropic · Claude
label: Pricing
sw: Claude API ina token pricing. Docs zinaeleza starter credits; check eligibility na balance. Claude chat na API si plan moja.
en: Claude API has token pricing. The docs describe starter credits; check eligibility and balance. Claude chat and API billing are separate.

name: Alibaba Model Studio · Qwen
label: Quota policy
sw: Eligible first-time Singapore activations zina time-limited quota. Check model na region; usichukulie kila Qwen kuwa free.
en: Eligible first-time Singapore activations have time-limited quota. Check the model and region; not every Qwen endpoint is free.

name: Google · Gemini API
label: Billing
sw: Free tier kwa selected models, verification kwa baadhi ya projects. Angalia quota, eligibility na data terms kabla ya test.
en: Free tier for selected models; some projects require verification. Review quotas, eligibility and data terms before testing.

name: OpenRouter
label: Limits
sw: Tumia exact :free variant iliyopo. Docs: 20 RPM na kawaida 50 requests/day kwa free-account tier. Paid ID na add-ons zinaweza kutozwa.
en: Use an available exact :free variant. Docs: 20 RPM and typically 50 requests/day on the free-account tier. Paid IDs and add-ons can incur charges.

name: GroqCloud
label: Limits
sw: Free-plan quotas hubadilika kwa model na org. Qwen ipo kwenye list ya limits; soma RPM/RPD/TPM ya account yako.
en: Free-plan quotas vary by model and organization. Qwen appears in its limits table; check your own RPM, RPD and TPM.

name: Cerebras Inference
label: Pricing
sw: $0 tier imeandikwa, rate limits ni ndogo zaidi. Check supported models na context ya tier yako.
en: A $0 tier is listed with lower rate limits. Check the currently supported models and context limits for your tier.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
label: Pricing
sw: Docs: 10,000 Neurons/day — kitengo cha compute, si requests. Kazi kubwa ihitaji paid plan; si kila model ipo kwenye Free.
en: Docs: 10,000 Neurons/day, a compute unit—not requests. Beyond that requires Paid; some models require Paid in the first place.

name: NVIDIA Build · NIM
label: Dev endpoint
sw: Endpoints zenye badge Free Endpoint ni za development pamoja na trial terms. Shared traffic inaweza kukufanya uthrottliwe.
en: Free Endpoint badges identify developer trial endpoints. Shared traffic can trigger throttling; review the trial terms.

name: Zro · MoonMath.ai
label: Pricing
sw: Docs zinaonyesha daily usage ya DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Kiasi hakiko wazi kwenye pricing; usihamishe offer hiyo kwa GLM au tools.
en: The Free plan lists daily DeepSeek V4.1 Flash usage. The public price page does not specify a quantity; don't apply it to GLM or tools.

name: Token Harbor
label: Pricing & data
sw: Selected :free models, allowance ya rolling siku 7. Opt-in ya free routes inaweza kuruhusu prompt/response retention; tumia dummy data.
en: Selected :free models have a rolling 7-day allowance. Opting in can allow prompt/response retention; use dummy data.

name: OpenCode Console
label: Free models
sw: Free chat models kadhaa ni za muda na zinahitaji OpenCode. Si API key ya bure ya kuhamishia client yoyote. Data policy hutofautiana.
en: Some temporary free chat models require OpenCode itself. Not a portable free API key for any client. Data policies differ by endpoint.

name: Puter.js
label: User-Pays
sw: User-Pays: free monthly allowance, kisha mtumiaji anaweza kulipia kupitia account yake. SDK route, si unrestricted Claude API key.
en: User-Pays: a monthly free allowance, then the user can pay on their account. This is an SDK route, not an unrestricted Claude API key.

name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
label: Billing
sw: Docs za sasa zinaonyesha hakuna included monthly credits kwa Free accounts. Top up au paid plan; model weights si hosted usage.
en: Current docs show no included monthly credits for Free accounts. Buy credits or use a paid plan; model weights aren't hosted usage.

name: Ollama · Qwen local
label: Local tags
sw: Run compatible weights kwenye machine yako bila hosted API key. Angalia RAM, storage, speed na license ya variant.
en: Run supported weights on your own machine without a hosted API key. Check RAM, storage, speed and the exact variant's license.
